parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The region where your devices reside. The region you specify must match the region that is specified in the console. Example: cn-shanghai.

>  This parameter is no longer used as an operation-specific request parameter. It is included in common request parameters.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The destination topic that receives messages.

parameters.name: Topic
parameters.description: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes](~~87387~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-topic-reverse-route-table --iot-instance-id iot-cn-0pp1n8t0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --topic /x7aWKW9000/testDataToDataHub/user/update --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
